items.title: Hypercoverings of a space by basic opens
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Construct a hypercovering (I, {U_i}) of a topological space X with all U_i in a basis B by induction on truncation: define n-truncated hypercoverings where the conditions are required only for simplices of degree <= n; the lemma reduces to extending an n-truncated hypercovering with U_i in B to an (n+1)-truncated one without adding lower simplices: take I' = sk_{n+1}(cosk_n I) whose I'_{n+1} consists of compatible tuples (i_0,...,i_{n+1}); for degenerate i' = s(i) set U_{i'} = U_i and J_{i'} = {i'}; for nondegenerate i' choose a B-covering of the intersection U_{i_0} cap ... cap U_{i_{n+1}} (equation-choose-covering); set I_{n+1} = coprod_{i'} J_{i'} with the canonical projection pi bijective over degenerate simplices, define faces through pi and degeneracies as the unique lifts, and conclude.
